1.story: The run opened with [Aneet in a tie giving three skincare rules](P01), 7.3× its usual, then a [Kareena birthday montage](P02) at 3.2×. Next came a phone-map reel, a [13-second ice-dunking warning](P04) at 11×, a Fashion Week poster and a zodiac carousel that landed about its usual. Then [the ice episode](P07) went to 92× its usual. A kajal award carousel, a gel jar carousel and a love-languages list finished above the usual.
1.going: Lakmē was setting up Skinterventions, a series fronted by its made-up Skin Goals Officer, and using Aneet in a tie to point viewers at it. Around that it kept a star tribute, an award, a Fashion Week date and a lip-shade list running.
1.landing: The run typically went 3.4× its usual; the run before was 1.18×. Everything that carried it had Aneet in her vest and tie. [Her ice warning](P04) named a habit viewers do, and [the episode](P07) let a girl dunk her face for 15 seconds before the gel appeared at 0:41. The [gel carousel](P09), same product, opened on a cheek swipe and a claim and got about a 29th of the episode's likes. Tributes, the award and lists landed lowest.
1.lesson: Show the habit before the product. The same gel went from 92× its usual to 3.4× once nobody was caught doing something silly first. Keep the officer in her costume and keep tributes and lists as filler around her.
